text: ®m Aview is defined using the create view statement which has the form create view v as < query expression > where <query expression> is any legal SQL expression. The view name is represented by v. ® Once a view is defined, the view name can be used to refer to the virtual relation that the view generates. ®m View definition is not the same as creating a new relation by evaluating the query expression » Rather, a view definition causes the saving of an expression; the expression is substituted into queries using the view.
